item.title: Blog — Coming Soon
item.description: I'm setting up a blog to share thoughts on Drupal, AI, LLM integrations, and open source. Stay tuned.
item.content:encoded:
Blog — Coming Soon

I've been meaning to write for a while. Between shipping features at Redfin Solutions and tinkering with LLM integrations on nights and weekends, there's a lot to share.

What to expect

  • Drupal deep-dives — migrations, custom modules, performance tuning
  • AI + LLM in the real world — what actually works when you bolt AI onto a CMS
  • Open source notes — contributions, lessons, and the occasional war story

Why now?

The site just got rebuilt in Svelte 5. Adding a blog felt like the obvious next move — and yes, any page on this site can be read in plain markdown by appending .md to the URL.

Stay tuned. First real post coming soon.
